fullPassage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on imitating the success of others. Failure does. Success does not arise from following in the path of someone else. Failure does. Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only imitate them. But an imitation is just a poor copy, it is never the real thing; it is fool's gold. The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a forgery. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from finding that which is successful in you and following your own path.

questions.passage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on ①<u>imitating</u> the success of others. Failure does. The reflection in the mirror can never be the person ③<u>stood</u> before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a forgery. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① imitating: depend on + 동명사 — 올바름
✅ ② following: arise from + 동명사 — 올바름
❌ ③ stood: the person 뒤에서 능동적으로 서 있는 상태를 수식하므로 현재분사 standing이 올바름
✅ ④ successful: which is + 형용사 — 올바름
det.tip: 현재분사(standing): 능동/진행 의미로 명사를 수식

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① depend: does not + 동사원형 — 올바름
✅ ② imitate: can only + 동사원형 — 올바름

✅ ④ look: they(주어 복수) + 동사원형 — 올바름
det.tip: fool's gold: 바보의 금 (= 겉만 번지르르한 것). 소유격 's 필수

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① standing: the person standing(현재분사 후치수식) — 올바름
❌ ② be: come from + 동명사 구조에서 동사원형 불가 → being 필요
✅ ③ successful: that which is successful(형용사 보어) — 올바름
✅ ④ following: come from finding... and following(동명사 병렬) — 올바름
det.tip: come from + 동명사: come from being (O) / come from be (X)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① them: others(사람 복수)를 가리키는 목적격 대명사 — 올바름
✅ ② they: reflection과 person(둘)을 가리키는 복수 대명사 — 올바름
✅ ③ Everyone: 부정대명사, 단수 취급 + knows — 올바름
❌ ④ who: 선행사가 that(= the thing, 사물)이므로 사물 관계대명사 which가 올바름. who는 사람에게만 사용
det.tip: that which: that은 선행사(사물), which는 관계대명사. who는 사람에게만

The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a forgery. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from finding that which is successful in you and following your own path.
